key_questions.answer: Yes, more dilution than the 8-Ks show. The proxy record date (09-24) shows 147,782,141 shares against 136,203,579 on 07-24, +11.58m (+8.5%) in two months. The two note-for-stock 8-Ks explain 4.22m (TLRY 27 notes $6m on 08-04 and $12m between 08-31 and 09-08, at $4.36 and $4.22 a share), and named insiders' RSU/PSU settlements net of tax withholding ~1.40m. The remaining ~6.0m shares are most likely ATM sales under the April $180m program, which had ~$89.5m left after 06-04; that is an inference the 10-Q will confirm. The TLRY 27 notes fall to ~$52m from $88m at 05-31. Asking what the money buys: BrewDog working capital and growth (~GBP50m since March) and retiring the June 2027 notes, not distress. The count has been public since 09-28, but data vendors still carry ~136m shares.
